title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-kkj5: encode_credential uses map(2) for 3-entry COSE_Key
description: In edhoc.rs:439-448, encode_credential() encodes a COSE_Key with 3 entries (kty=1 at label 1, crv=6 at label -1, pubkey bstr at label -2), but the CBOR map header is `0xa2` (map of 2) instead of `0xa3` (map of 3). This produces a malformed COSE_Key — CBOR parsers would expect only 2 entries but find 3, causing interop failures. Fix: change `0xa2` to `0xa3` on line 441.
